issues.where: GX.E0Surgery.IsE0C1SpacelikeCauchy.rim (l.2589-2593); consequences: exists_isE0C1SpacelikeCauchy (G0, l.2908), regM_isCauchyComplete_of_C1, exists_surgeryData and every hS-taking lemma; REPORT row prop:abs_max (questions 1-2)
issues.problem: The field `rim` asks for ContDiff ℝ 1 (rimFun τS R) for EVERY τS satisfying ∀ x ∈ spear v R, (ψ(paperInY x) ∈ S ↔ x.1 = τS x.2). It does not require the shaft condition ∀ z, ‖z‖ ≤ R → v + R/2 < τS z. Without that condition, τS is unconstrained wherever the vertical line over z inside the spear misses S. Take a valid datum D, raise the vertex to v' > max(D.v, sup over the disc of D.τS). The spear v' R then misses S. Any τS' lying below v' satisfies the iff, including a discontinuous one: τS' z = if 0 < z.im then v'-1 else v'-2. The field then demands that this function be C^1. Proved by the auditor, with axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only: `theorem audit_C1_vacuous (D : SpearSurgeryDatum M S) (hS : IsE0C1SpacelikeCauchy M S) : False`. With the file's exists_spearSurgeryDatum this gives `hGH → hS → hmax → p ∈ S0 M → p ∈ I⁻(S) → False`. Consequences. (a) IsE0C1SpacelikeCauchy M S holds only if no BTZ point lies in I⁻(S). (b) regM_isCauchyComplete_of_C1 is vacuous in exactly the case B21 Prop 2.17's surgery addresses. (c) Any SurgeryData with nonempty ι contradicts hS, so (G1)-(G5) would all become trivially provable from a false hypothesis. (d) (G0) exists_isE0C1SpacelikeCauchy is FALSE whenever every Cauchy surface has a BTZ point in its chronological past (any BTZ line, with the vertices of Lemma 2.4). Yet regM_isCauchyComplete is now 'proved' by composing through it. A tagged sorry on a false statement is not a legitimate obstruction (CAMPAIGN 'State first', kb/0011).
issues.fix: Add the shaft condition (and, if wanted, ContinuousOn τS (closedBall 0 R)) to the antecedent of `rim`: `(∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ R → v + R / 2 < τS z) → (∀ x ∈ spear v R, …) → ContDiff ℝ 1 (rimFun τS R)`. Then (τS z, z) ∈ spear v R for ‖z‖ ≤ R, so τS is determined on the closed disc by S and the field states what B21 l.227 means. exists_spearSurgeryDatum already has this hypothesis (h1 from lem_add_BTZ_param_of_cauchyMaximal), and SpearSurgeryDatum.exists_shrink has it (hshaft), so both call sites change by one argument. Then re-check that no other field of IsE0C1SpacelikeCauchy or SpearSurgeryDatum is contradictory, for example by deriving False from it as audit_C1_vacuous does. Record the defect and the repair in the REPORT.

counterexample_lean:
open scoped Real; namespace GX.E0Surgery; open E0
theorem audit_C1_vacuous {M : Type} [TopologicalSpace M] [T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [SecondCountableTopology M] [ChartedSpace E0Y M] [HasGroupoid M e0Groupoid] {S : Set M} (D : SpearSurgeryDatum M S) (hS : IsE0C1SpacelikeCauchy M S) : False := by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) D.R).bddAbove_image D.continuousOn
  set v' : ℝ := max D.v T + 1
  have hvv : D.v ≤ v' := by simp only [v']; linarith [le_max_left D.v T]
  have hsub : E0Spear.spear v' D.R ⊆ E0Spear.spear D.v D.R := E0Spear.spear_mono hvv le_rfl
  let τS' : ℂ → ℝ := fun z => if 0 < z.im then v' - 1 else v' - 2
  have hgraph : ∀ x ∈ E0Spear.spear v' D.R, (D.ψ (paperInY x) ∈ S ↔ x.1 = τS' x.2) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx1 : v' ≤ x.1 := by have h := hx.1; simp only [fcoord] at h; linarith [rad_nonneg x]
    rw [D.graph x (hsub hx)]
    have hb : D.τS x.2 ≤ T := hT ⟨x.2, by have := hx.2; simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, rad] using this, rfl⟩
    have hTv : T < v' := by simp only [v']; linarith [le_max_right D.v T]
    constructor
    · intro h; linarith
    · intro h; exfalso
      have : τS' x.2 ≤ v' - 1 := by simp only [τS']; split_ifs <;> linarith
      linarith
  have hC1 := hS.rim D.R v' D.W D.ψ τS' D.pos D.isOpen ((image_mono hsub).trans D.spear_sub) D.mor D.inj hgraph
  have hcont : Continuous (rimFun τS' D.R) := hC1.continuous
  have him : ∀ θ : ℝ, ((D.R : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)).im = D.R * Real.sin θ := by
    intro θ; rw [Complex.im_ofReal_mul, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
  have h0 : rimFun τS' D.R 0 = v' - 2 := by simp only [rimFun, τS', him, Real.sin_zero, mul_zero, lt_irrefl, if_false]
  have hpos : ∀ θ, 0 < θ → θ < π → rimFun τS' D.R θ = v' - 1 := by
    intro θ h1 h2; simp only [rimFun, τS', him]; rw [if_pos (mul_pos D.pos (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi h1 h2))]
  have ht : Tendsto (rimFun τS' D.R) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (v' - 2)) := by rw [← h0]; exact hcont.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hev : (fun θ => rimFun τS' D.R θ) =ᶠ[𝓝[>] 0] fun _ => v' - 1 := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT Real.pi_pos] with θ hθ using hpos θ hθ.1 hθ.2
  have ht2 : Tendsto (rimFun τS' D.R) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (v' - 1)) := (tendsto_congr' hev).2 tendsto_const_nhds
  have := tendsto_nhds_unique ht ht2
  linarith
